info.name: Retrieve list of URLs for a given dataset

items.docs:
Retrieve list of URLs for a given dataset and timeframe.

Notes:
  - start and end times are inclusive
  - start and end time format is YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS. Excluding values from the right to 
    the left result in default values being used (eg. YYYY-mm-ddTHH results in YYYY-mm-ddTHH:00:00)
  - dataset matching is case insensitive
  - site_uid is expected to be the 4-letter site code, and is case insensitive
  - device_uid is expected to be the instrument identifier such as "themis02", "rego-65

info.name: Retrieve imaging start and end times for a set of locations

items.docs:
Retrieve imaging start and end times for a set of locations. This is specific to the optical 
instrumentation we provide data for.

The timestamp is expected to be UTC time.

Each location in the 'locations' array can be specified either by a 4-letter site UID, or by
providing geodetic latitude and longitude. If the site_uid is provided, it is resolved to
coordinates using the known observatory list.
